rationale: Micah brings deep expertise in visual interfaces for machine learning and data products—skills that could be valuable as DreamInk explores the intersection of brand entertainment and emerging technologies. While their domains differ, Micah's track record building intuitive AI tooling and his conviction that interactive visualization unlocks AI's business potential aligns with Konstantin's focus on product-driven experiences in the entertainment space.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Konstantin Baumer — you're both building products at the intersection of emerging tech and user experience, and your complementary backgrounds in AI tooling and brand entertainment could spark some interesting conversations.
